phase: Phase 1 — NASA imagery and provenance viewer
data_policy: NASA mission data and NASA mission metadata only. Do not substitute modeled, synthetic, or assumed values for missing observations. This build contains imagery/context and coordinate annotations only; it is not an operational safety or routing product.

area_of_interest.definition: Project-defined rectangular study area; coordinates are not a measured terrain boundary.
area_of_interest.coordinate_reference: Project-defined degree coordinates; cross-source CRS alignment to the CTX service is unvalidated.

layers.name: MRO Context Camera (CTX) regional mosaic
layers.data_type: Grayscale orbital image mosaic; not an elevation model
layers.service_operator: Bruce Murray Laboratory / Caltech OnMars MapServer, exposed by the NASA Mars Trek WMTS resource
layers.retrieval_result: 30 of 30 required 512x512 PNG tiles returned HTTP 200, decoded successfully, and recorded with byte counts and SHA-256 digests.
layers.georeferencing_note: The crop is arranged from the service tile matrix. NASA Mars Trek WMTS advertises ESRI:104905, while its linked ArcGIS REST MapServer reports WKID 104971; the mismatch is unresolved. No external coordinate annotations are drawn pending reconciliation and independent registration validation.
limitations: Image only; not a numeric DEM
Not suitable for walking-scale slope, obstacle clearance, or route-safety calculations
Nominal pixel scale is not a claim of uniform source-image resolution or positional accuracy
External AOI/waypoint/observation coordinates are not overlaid because the advertised and REST service spatial references differ.

layers.name: MGS MOLA global color shaded-relief tile
layers.data_type: Rendered shaded-relief image; not numeric elevation samples
layers.provider: NASA Mars Trek / USGS Astrogeology product service
layers.viewer_use: Separate thumbnail only; not georegistered as an overlay; no elevation range, contour, or slope is derived from this raster.
limitations: Rendered color/shaded-relief visualization, not a numeric DEM

layers.name: HiRISE observation PSP_001752_1750
layers.viewer_use: Source card only. No footprint, swath polygon, image coverage, local image detail, or point marker is asserted in the map.

layers.name: MSL Curiosity Sol 4452 waypoint
layers.viewer_use: NASA coordinate reference only; not drawn on the raster pending CRS reconciliation.

layers.name: Curiosity Mastcam boxwork panorama PIA26559
